execution.isolation: Give one raw input and the runtime skill path to a fresh context. Hide other cases and the rubric.
execution.permissions: Allow skill resource reads only. Prohibit writes, network, execution, Git, credentials and delegation.
execution.assessment: Judge the actual proposal or review semantically. Parsing and execution must be reported separately.

cases.input: In chat, use exactly Source, Consumer Impact, and Evidence. Review our read-only integration using provider OpenAPI 3.1.2 at revision r7. Provider proposes changing GET /items to QUERY /items with a JSON body in r8. Our gateway and generated consumer are pinned to the current edition; no compatibility tests ran. We own only the consumer. Explain how to proceed without editing the provider definition or changing our approved toolchain.
expected: Use the three supplied sections and identify r7 as the current provider baseline.
Distinguish HTTP QUERY semantics, OpenAPI support, and toolchain support. Identify the breaking change and give a workable option or blocker within consumer authority.
Report actual verification limits and name the evidence needed for any transition.
prohibited: Rewrite the provider contract, upgrade the toolchain, or claim executed compatibility tests
cases.quality: The recommendation remains actionable without unilaterally changing a provider contract or an approved dependency.

cases.input: Propose an AsyncAPI 3.1 contract outline in chat from the Orders publisher's perspective. Shipping consumes OrderPlaced on the shared broker. Delivery is at least once; the intended duplicate detection uses event ID. Ordering is per order key. The broker family, retention, and retry policy are not selected. Provide a useful outline, identify open decisions and verification limits, and preserve the edition. Do not create files or change the consumer contract.
expected: Model the publisher as send and keep the consumer responsibility distinct. Use consistent channel, message and operation references.
Specify stable event identity and ordering scope. Explain duplicate and retry/replay consequences using the given delivery guarantee.
Leave binding, retention and retry decisions open. Distinguish reviewed content from validator or broker results.
prohibited: Copy a receiver operation from the template, invent broker settings, promise exactly-once effects, or write files
cases.quality: The outline can be reviewed against the existing consumer contract before transport-specific policies are selected.
